summary:
This is a strong response. It refuses to give a single score, rates RabbitMQ recovery as Visible (well below Recoverable), names the single-expert dependency, says page count is not control, and proposes a concrete recovery exercise run by a second engineer. Its main gap is the dashboards: it questions whether anyone knows which signals matter, but never says that per-service dashboards don't follow dependency paths. Two smaller points:
